name: certificate-week
title: Certificate evidence this week
subtitle: Fictional demo until your checked records are imported. Record checks do not establish insurance cover.

sections.title: Renewals in the next 60 days and expired records
sections.sql: select vendor,name,replace(coverage,'_',' ') as coverage,expires_on,days_left,owner from certificates.renewals

sections.title: Documents awaiting review
sections.sql: select vendor,name,policy,replace(coverage,'_',' ') as coverage,review_state from certificates.review_queue
